_comment: Run `swytchcode init` in this directory, then `swytchcode add <spec> <canonical_id>` for each integration below. Swytchcode will fill in `tools` and `integrations` itself. DO NOT hand-write canonical IDs here — copy them from `swytchcode info <canonical_id>` after `swytchcode add` so they match what your workspace actually has registered.

resolve_ai_action_map._comment: Maps this app's internal action names to the REAL canonical_id Swytchcode gave you after `swytchcode add`. Left blank on purpose — the backend refuses to guess. Example once populated: 'notion.search': 'notion.pages.search'
